suggestions.description: Required. The assistant suggested user responses. These are suggestions for the user on how to interact with the assistant.

serviceDirectoryConfig.description: Optional. Service Directory configuration for VPC-SC, used to resolve service names within a perimeter.

customHeaders.description: Optional. The custom headers to send in the request to the MCP server. The values must be in the format `$context.variables.` and can be set in the session variables. See https://docs.cloud.google.com/customer-engagement-ai/conversational-agents/ps/tool/open-api#openapi-injection for more details.

name.description: Required. The name of the MCP tool.

nameOverride.description: Optional. The name override of the MCP tool. This is populated if the name was overridden by a Toolset override.

tlsConfig.description: Optional. The TLS configuration. Includes the custom server certificates that the client should trust.

serverAddress.description: Required. The server address of the MCP server, e.g., "https://example.com/mcp/". If the server is built with the MCP SDK, the url should be suffixed with "/mcp/". Only Streamable HTTP transport based servers are supported. This is the same as the server_address in the McpToolset. See https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-03-26/basic/transports#streamable-http for more details.

outputSchema.description: Optional. The schema of the output arguments of the MCP tool.

apiAuthentication.description: Optional. Authentication information required to execute the tool against the MCP server. For bearer token authentication, the token applies only to tool execution, not to listing tools. This requires that tools can be listed without authentication.

enumDescriptions: Default state.
The tool is available and actively offered by the server.
The tool is configured or pinned, but currently not offered by the server.
The tool exists on the server, but does not match the version on the server.
state.description: Output only. The dynamic availability state of the tool on the external server.

inputSchema.description: Optional. The schema of the input arguments of the MCP tool.

description.description: Optional. The description of the MCP tool.

McpTool.description: An MCP tool. See https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/server/tools for more details.

EvaluationResultScenarioResult.description: The outcome of a scenario evaluation.

userFacts.description: Output only. The user facts that were used by the scenario for this result.

toolCallLatencies.description: Output only. The latency of each tool call execution in the conversation.

expectationOutcomes.description: Output only. The outcome of each expectation.

userGoalSatisfactionResult.description: Output only. The result of the user goal satisfaction check.

milestoneResults.description: Output only. The results of each milestone in the scenario.

taskCompletionResult.description: Output only. The result of the task completion check.

task.description: Output only. The task that was used when running the scenario for this result.

conversation.description: Output only. The conversation that was generated in the scenario.

hallucinationResult.description: Output only. The result of the hallucination check. There will be one hallucination result for each turn in the conversation.

allExpectationsSatisfied.description: Output only. Whether all expectations were satisfied for this turn.

evaluationExpectationResults.description: Output only. The results of the evaluation expectations.

spanLatencies.description: Output only. The latency of spans in the conversation.

taskCompleted.description: Output only. Whether the task was completed for this turn. This is a composite of all expectations satisfied, no hallucinations, and user goal satisfaction.

rubricOutcomes.description: Output only. The outcome of the rubric.

LfA2aV1AgentExtension.description: A declaration of a protocol extension supported by an Agent.

uri.description: The unique URI identifying the extension.

description.description: A human-readable description of how this agent uses the extension.

required.description: If true, the client must understand and comply with the extension's requirements.

defaultDashboard.description: Optional. The resource name of the default Contact Center Insights dashboard associated with the app. This is the dashboard that will be displayed when users navigate to the Monitoring view for the app. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/dashboards/{dashboard}`

DashboardSettings.description: Settings for dashboards associated with the app, that show up in the Monitoring view.

deletedConversations.description: The list of conversations that were successfully deleted.

errorMessages.description: Optional. A list of error messages associated with conversations that failed to be deleted.

failedConversations.description: The list of conversations that failed to be deleted.

GenerateAppResourceRequestQualityReportG.description: The configuration to be used for quality report generation.

algorithm.description: Optional. The loss attribution algorithm to use.
enumDescriptions: Unspecified.
App-centric loss attribution. Treats the app as a single unit.
Agent-centric loss attribution. Attributes loss to individual agents.

evaluationRun.description: Required. The evaluation run used to inform quality report analysis.

type.description: Optional. The type of the supervisor.
enumDescriptions: Type is unspecified.
Invalid text issue type.
Language shift issue type.
Speaker shift issue type.
Audio mismatch issue type.
Missing tool call issue type.
Custom issue type.
Choppy audio issue type.
Agent profanity issue type.
Thought leakage issue type: the agent spoke internal reasoning, instructions, variables, or function names aloud.
Automated bot issue type: the incoming caller (the end user) is an automated bot, e.g. a text-to-speech voice, rather than a live human.

detectionMode.description: Optional. The detection mode of the supervisor.
enumDescriptions: Detection mode is unspecified. Default to NON_BLOCKING.
Non blocking detection mode. Response is not blocked when the supervisor detection is ongoing.
Blocking detection mode. Response is blocked when the supervisor detection is ongoing.

LfA2aV1TaskStatusUpdateEvent.description: An event sent by the agent to notify the client of a change in a task's status.

contextId.description: Required. The ID of the context that the task belongs to.

metadata.description: Optional. Metadata associated with the task update.

taskId.description: Required. The ID of the task that has changed.

status.description: Required. The new status of the task.

EndSession.description: Indicates the session has terminated, due to either successful completion (e.g. user says "Good bye!" ) or an agent escalation. The agent will not process any further inputs after session is terminated and the client should half-close and disconnect after receiving all remaining responses from the agent.

metadata.description: Optional. Provides additional information about the end session signal, such as the reason for ending the session.

OpenApiToolset.description: A toolset that contains a list of tools that are defined by an OpenAPI schema.

apiAuthentication.description: Optional. Authentication information required by the API.

tlsConfig.description: Optional. The TLS configuration. Includes the custom server certificates

url.description: Optional. The server URL of the Open API schema. This field is only set in toolsets in the environment dependencies during the export process if the schema contains a server url. During the import process, if this url is present in the environment dependencies and the schema has the $env_var placeholder, it will replace the placeholder in the schema.

ignoreUnknownFields.description: Optional. If true, the agent will ignore unknown fields in the API response for all operations defined in the OpenAPI schema.

openApiSchema.description: Required. The OpenAPI schema of the toolset.
